primary_gt.one_sentence_check: The 10/10 ledger supports the regional smoke-aerosol label, while the population and facility counts remain separate local context values.

criteria.description: Returns regional_smoke_aerosol, total_score = 10, and the compact regional_smoke_aerosol_score_10 answer string.
criteria.name: Final structured answer
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2 points for the right label with the wrong total, or 1 point for a smoke-related label without the ledger total.

criteria.description: Identifies the smoke-river phrase, all four source-belt regions, and the 20-mile fire-front value.
criteria.name: Event-report extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for the phrase, 2 points for at least three correct regions, and 1 point for the fire-front value within 1 mile.

criteria.description: Computes 47 inclusive days from 2000-08-14 to 2000-09-29 and applies the 30-day threshold correctly.
criteria.name: Aerosol-window arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2 points for the correct dates with an off-by-one day count, and 1 point for recognizing that the window passes the threshold without showing the formula.

criteria.description: Credits the grass/shrubland source phrase and verifies that 2000-08-31 lies inside the event window with a 35-degree snapshot span.
criteria.name: Source and image tests
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for the source phrase and 1-2 points for partially correct image-date or span checks.

criteria.description: Reports pre_count = 0, post_count = 0, population_2000 = 72066, facility_count = 4, and highway_elements = 42.
criteria.name: Burn-index and context counts
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for the burn-index counts or 1 point for at least two correct local context counts.

criteria.description: Keeps the seven threshold-test point values separate from local context counts and returns compact JSON with the requested keys.
criteria.name: Ledger discipline and format
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for correct reasoning with missing JSON keys or for mixing a context count into the 10-point score.
